name: hob
description: The household's todos, the ward, and whatever else hob can do, as tools in Claude Code. The tools are served by hob itself, so they follow what hob can do.

url.title: hob's URL
url.description: Where hob answers, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://hob.example

key.title: A person's hob key
key.description: A key for you on a claude-code surface: bin/rails "hob:key[<you>,claude-code]". Kept in the keychain.

clearance.title: Clearance cap
clearance.description: The highest realm Claude Code may see: household, personal, or intimate. It can only lower what the key allows.
